UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow Light Corporate theme: Deep Navy (#0B192C), Royal Blue (#1E56A0), Warm Amber Gold (#D4AF37), and Crisp White/Off-White canvas.
Ensure header has solid glassmorphic background (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md) with border-b so text is never placed over raw images with zero background.
Use Manrope / Inter sans-serif pairing with tight tracking on headings and generous vertical spacing (py-16 to py-24 for sections).
Include data-testid on every interactive element (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, cards).
Implement the Contact Us form to generate a structured mailto link to savariyaoverseas@gmail.com with subject and body pre-filled with inquiry details.
Provide mobile sticky bottom bar with Quick Call, Direct Email, and Request Quote triggers.
Do not invent fake logos, certificates, or awards; use clean professional badge designs and clearly labeled industry capabilities.
